hook: This AI chip runs on light, not electricity.
hookText: Photonic chips run AI on light

beats.say: As AI becomes part of everyday life, the energy required to run the models is ballooning, and labs are hunting for cheaper ways to compute.
German company Q.ANT is building photonic processors, chips that use light to perform the toughest calculations, and the goal is to cut the energy AI models need.
The chips need only ninety nanometer technology from the two thousands, and Q.ANT says it is ready if an order for one hundred thousand processors arrived.
